findings.title: Missing n! in advertised toric Ruelle invariant
hypotheses_checked: Round E(a,...,a), n>=2,a>0; smooth strictly convex star-shaped toric domain
Canonical H=pi sum|z|^2/a; standard trivialization and c1=0
Actual stated invariant measure omega^n; angle periods1 and moment simplex volume a^n/n!
Explicit unitary linearized flow has determinant slope n/a
findings.decisive_evidence: Ru by definition =n a^(n-1); printed toric expression=n a^(n-1)/n!. For n2,a1,2 versus1. omega^n pushforward is n! dmu, unlike the printed formula.
findings.core_dependency: Advertised Proposition1.9/5.6 value feeds Proposition5.16; normalization also enters Section4.4 quantitative chain.
findings.impact: Central exact invariant value false. Qualitative nonconvexity construction not disproved and corrected growth still tends to infinity.
findings.repair_verification: Insert n! while keeping stated measures; consistent renormalization requires changes across domain/boundary definitions. Report proves improved sandwich exponent (L-1)d^2/2, which absorbs factorial and recovers listed loose C(n) even for metric volume; not an assertion that listed constant is false.
findings.severity_basis: An explicit central quantitative conclusion fails for allowed smooth ellipsoids; unchanged qualitative application does not make its value correct.

findings.title: False universal automorphism bound and endpoint gauge identity
hypotheses_checked: Compact circle base with translation flow and probability measure
Trivial symplectic line, c1=0, identity cocycle
Psi_N=e^(2pi i N sin2pi x) is smooth unitary and homotopic to identity
Rotation lift starts at0; no reduction modulo integers
findings.decisive_evidence: Correct gauge uses Psi(phi_t x) and Psi(x)^-1. Its lift difference is N(sin2pi(x+t)-sin2pi x), equal-2N at x1/4,t1/2. No fixed C or3c bounds allN.
findings.core_dependency: Printed conjugation proof is used for independence of compatible complex structure.
findings.impact: Universal bound false; fixed-automorphism asymptotic density invariance survives.
findings.repair_verification: Bound by2B_Psi+3D using bounded continuous lift over compact base and correct endpoint product. This is uniform in t,x, may depend onPsi, and divided byT gives0 for actual Proposition3.11 use.
findings.severity_basis: Verified weaker statement suffices for the downstream conclusion.

findings.title: Wrong coefficient in complex-to-real trace identity
hypotheses_checked: A=I_2n symplectic
S=I_2n positive definite
TU_I(J)=J, U=I
findings.decisive_evidence: Complex trace ni differs from printed2i*realtrace(I_2n)=4ni. Correct coefficient i/2.
findings.core_dependency: Trace bound supplies upper Ruelle estimate.
findings.impact: False identity but the corrected factor gives a stronger bound and preserves all stated downstream upper constants.
findings.repair_verification: Diagonalize skew-Hermitian K: tr_C K=(i/2)tr_R(J^-1 K); source real bound8n^2 then gives4n^2, below stated16n^2.
findings.severity_basis: No loss of asserted upper estimate after exact local correction.

findings.title: Incorrect homothetic metric factor and divergence slope
hypotheses_checked: Euclidean punctured R^d with V=x/2 is cylindrical and L_Vg=g
Constant unit coordinate U=W
For slope test U=V has L_VU=0 and divV=d/2
findings.decisive_evidence: Lemma4.4 LHS1 versus RHS1/2. divV nonzero constant has slope0 not-1. General divergence is natural trace of covariant derivative and retains slopea.
findings.core_dependency: Homothety formulas support variation and sandwich proof.
findings.impact: Local assertions false; proof text and actual later use employ correct metric factor and divergence slope.
findings.repair_verification: Replace half inner product by full inner product; divergence slopea, gradient/Laplacian a-1. Actual (4.5) already uses correct slope1.
findings.severity_basis: Corrections agree with later valid calculation; no new failure of sandwich estimate demonstrated.

findings.title: Unattained bracket minimum on an open face
hypotheses_checked: Moment simplex x1+x2<=1,x>=0 gives smooth concave star-shaped toric ball
v=(1,2) allowed nonzero nonnegative integer vector
S={1,2}; face excludes both endpoints
findings.decisive_evidence: On x=(1-s,s),0<s<1, pairing1+s has infimum1 and no minimum, so printed definition not well-defined.
findings.core_dependency: Bracket is used in cited systole formula and inclusion monotonicity.
findings.impact: Local domain defect; no counterexample to corrected capacity statement or systole monotonicity claimed.
findings.repair_verification: Use infimum or minimum on face closure; compactness/continuity and radial comparison preserve intended values and monotonicity. External capacity formula not independently reproved.
findings.severity_basis: A repaired definition is sufficient; qualitative construction not shown false.

findings.title: LCZ formulas refer to CZ outside its declared domain
hypotheses_checked: Identity endpoint belongs to universal symplectic cover
CZ only defined on nondegenerate endpoints by Section2.3
LCZ is intended on all endpoints, with LCZ(Id_2)=-1
findings.decisive_evidence: Definition2.11 permits approximants without nondegeneracy restriction, where CZ can be undefined. Lemma2.12(b) uses CZ(Phi) for arbitrary possibly identity Phi; det(Id-Id)=0. Replacing byLCZ makes identity direct sum -1-1=-2 consistent.
findings.core_dependency: Degenerate lower index is used for unipotent/closed-loop factors in Proposition5.8.
findings.impact: Domain/notation error, not a demonstrated failure of the resulting dynamical-convexity bound.
findings.repair_verification: Require nondegenerate approximating endpoints and LCZ on both direct-sum terms. Source subsequent estimate already uses LCZ and gives2m-m+(n-m)=n.
findings.severity_basis: Local type/domain correction preserves the intended index argument.

problems_checked.P1: Confirmed Major for a central explicit formula under the source's declared omega^n measure. With angle period1 and moment coordinates mu_j=pi|z_j|^2, pushforward(omega^n)=n!*dmu. On a smooth round ellipsoid E(a), the linear flow has rotation rate n/a and omega^n-volume a^n, so Ru=n*a^(n-1); the printed toric formula gives this divided by n!. At n=2,a=1 the values are2 and1. No degeneracy exclusion removes the admissible example. The factorial is present elsewhere in the source and cannot silently be dropped. Correcting it preserves divergence in the thin-ellipsoid qualitative construction, and the improved sandwich argument gives exponent (L-1)d^2/2. With L=(2n)^2,d=2n, the extra n! is absorbed using log(n!)<=n^2, recovering the source's loose C(n). Thus neither the qualitative nonconvex construction nor that upper constant is claimed false; the explicit normalization and its propagation require correction.
problems_checked.P2: Confirmed Minor on the quantifier. The true transformed cocycle is Psi(phi_t x)*Phi(t,x)*Psi(x)^-1. On a circle, Psi_N=exp(2pi*i*N*sin(2pi*x)) is a smooth null-homotopic automorphism; at x=1/4,t=1/2 its lift change is -2N. Hence no uniform constant over all Psi exists. For a fixed Psi, compactness bounds a chosen lift by B_Psi and the corrected 2B_Psi+3D estimate suffices for the later asymptotic invariant. No failure of that invariant follows.
problems_checked.P3: Confirmed Minor by A=S=I: TU_I(J)=J, complex trace is n*i, while the printed 2i times the real trace gives4n*i. The factor is i/2. This yields the stronger complex bound4n^2 from the checked real8n^2 bound, so the printed loose16n^2 upper estimate survives.
problems_checked.P4: Confirmed Minor. On Euclidean punctured space with cylindrical V=x/2, L_V g=g, but the two covariant terms sum to <U,W>, not one half of it. The divergence of V is the nonzero constant d/2 and has slope0, disproving the stated divergence shift to -1. Correct slopes are a for divergence and a-1 for gradient/Laplacian. The source's proof, volume scaling and subsequent Hessian argument use the correct factors; this local error is not promoted to a false sandwich theorem.
problems_checked.P5: Confirmed Minor for the open-face minimum. For the round-ball simplex and v=(1,2), points (1-s,s),0<s<1 have objective1+s, so the infimum1 is not attained. The simplex satisfies the allowed concavity of the orthant complement. Replacing min by inf, or using the face closure, repairs the expression and supports the stated radial monotonicity argument. The external capacity theorem was not independently reproved.
problems_checked.P6: Confirmed Minor domain/notation issue. CZ is defined only for nondegenerate endpoints, yet the approximation definition and direct-sum formula allow degenerate ones, including identity. The lower index LCZ is the relevant extension; LCZ(Id in dimension2)=-1 and direct sums give the corresponding sum. The later dynamical-convexity chain uses this lower index and yields 2m-m+(n-m)=n before the contact contribution-1. Thus no failure of the claimed convexity lower bound is established. Added explicit Problem6 for the existing finding.
